documents.text: Privacy Gizlinlik syýasaty Yuchen Water protects buyer inquiry information and uses submitted data only to respond to OEM/ODM water filtration requests. Information We Collect When you send an inquiry, we may collect your name, company, email address, WhatsApp number, country, product requirements, quantity, destination port and message details. How We Use The Information We use inquiry information to prepare quotations, confirm specifications, arrange samples, discuss shipping and follow up with technical or sales support. We do not sell buyer contact information. Form Delivery Inquiry forms are configured to send submissions to expresswater025@gmail.com. After a successful submission, the page shows a thank-you message so buyers know the request has been sent. Cookies And Analytics The website may use basic analytics or security tools to understand page performance and reduce spam. If additional tracking tools are added, cookie notice settings should be reviewed for GDPR and other regional requirements. Your Rights You can request correction or deletion of your inquiry information by emailing expresswater025@gmail.com or contacting WhatsApp sales at +86-19908311885.
